description: Reported values of one XBRL concept for one SEC filer, by CIK or ticker, from its SEC filings (EDGAR): each value with its period, fiscal year, form, filing date and accession number, the latest 40.

concept.description: XBRL concept name, default Revenues; others include RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, NetIncomeLoss, Assets

ticker.description: Stock ticker of an SEC filer, such as AAPL
